library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)

# Specify desired legend order
t12$Treatment <- factor(t12$Treatment, levels = c("SM9RTNB", "SM9RTB", "SM9VTNB", "SM9VTB", "NSM9RTNB", "NSM9RTB", "NSM9VTNB", "NSM9VTB", "SR2ARTNB", "SR2ARTB", "SR2AVTNB", "SR2AVTB", "NSR2ARTNB", "NSR2ARTB", "NSR2AVTNB", "NSR2AVTB","SCRRTNB", "SCRRTB", "SCRVTNB", "SCRVTB", "NSCRRTNB", "NSCRRTB", "NSCRVTNB", "NSCRVTB"))


# Build the plot
legend_plot <- ggplot(t12, aes(x = ComplexityB, y = hill1, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 24, title.position = "top")) +  # <- title above
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),  # Reduce margin around the entire legend box
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "pt"),  # Reduce vertical space between legend items
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "pt"),  # Reduce horizontal space between legend items
    legend.key.size = unit(1.3, "lines"),  # Reduce size of legend keys
    legend.title.align = 0.5  # Center-align title
  )
## Warning: The `legend.title.align` argument of `theme()` is deprecated as of ggplot2
## 3.5.0.
## ℹ Please use theme(legend.title = element_text(hjust)) instead.
## This warning is displayed once every 8 hours.
## Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was
## generated.
# Convert to grob
g <- ggplotGrob(legend_plot)

# Extract legend manually
legend_grob <- g$grobs[which(sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")][[1]]

#Boxplot of diversity metrics by treatment on T12

hill6 = ggplot(t12_6, aes(x=Treatment, y=hill1)) + 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(color=Treatment, reorder(Treatment, hill1))) + theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)) +ylab("ENS (q=1)") +scale_color_manual(values = color)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 12))+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),   # Light gray major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),   # Even lighter minor grid
    panel.background = element_blank()) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+ facet_wrap(~Experiment, ncol=1, scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels))

hill7 = ggplot(t12_7, aes(x=Treatment, y=hill1)) + 
  theme_bw()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(color=Treatment, reorder(Treatment, hill1))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 12))+ theme(legend.position="none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)) +ylab("ENS (q=1)") +scale_color_manual(values = color)+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),   # Light gray major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),   # Even lighter minor grid
    panel.background = element_blank()) +scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1))+ facet_wrap(~Experiment, ncol=1, scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels))

#Arrange plots and save as svg

combined_plot = ggarrange(regression7, regression6,hill7, hill6,  ncol = 2, nrow=2, align="hv", labels = c("A", "B",  "C", "D"), hjust=0.2, vjust=0.6, font.label = list(size = 15,family="serif")) 
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
combined_with_padding <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(combined_plot, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 10, unit = "mm"))

final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  combined_with_padding,

  ncol = 2,

)

#Figure 3 - GLM results observed and marginal

#S.R2A.RT.NB as reference
pmxc = read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC6_7_combined_ASVtable_OGperSample.csv", header=T)

t12 = pmxc[pmxc$Time == "T12",]

t12_6 = t12[t12$Experiment == "PMXC6",]

t12_7 = t12[t12$Experiment == "PMXC7",]

#Set reference levels for model
t12_6$Media <- factor(t12_6$Media, levels = c("R2A", "CR"))
t12_6$Temp <- factor(t12_6$Temp, levels = c("RT", "VT"))
t12_6$Shake <- factor(t12_6$Shake, levels = c("S", "NS"))
t12_6$Beads <- factor(t12_6$Beads, levels = c("NB", "B"))

t12_7$Media <- factor(t12_7$Media, levels = c("M9", "CR"))
t12_7$Temp <- factor(t12_7$Temp, levels = c("RT", "VT"))
t12_7$Shake <- factor(t12_7$Shake, levels = c("S", "NS"))
t12_7$Beads <- factor(t12_7$Beads, levels = c("NB", "B"))

#Run GLM on T12 usig Hill1 calculated with 1% abundance cutoff

#PMXC6 (CR.R2A)

#Run GLM model
glm_pmxc6T12 <- glm(hill1  ~ Media*Shake*Temp*Beads, data=t12_6,family = Gamma(link = "log"))

summary(glm_pmxc6T12)

## TempVT                         0.04517    0.11975   0.377 0.708505    
## BeadsB                         0.17189    0.11975   1.435 0.160861    
## MediaCR:ShakeNS               -0.40257    0.16935  -2.377 0.023591 *

## ShakeNS:BeadsB                -0.17189    0.16935  -1.015 0.317701    
## TempVT:BeadsB                 -0.49363    0.16935  -2.915 0.006446 ** 
## MediaCR:ShakeNS:TempVT         0.50968    0.23949   2.128 0.041118 *

library(sjPlot) 
## 
## Attaching package: 'sjPlot'

##     plot_grid, save_plot
glm_plot6 = plot_model(glm_pmxc6T12,show.values = TRUE, show.p=TRUE, value.offset=0.4,vline="black",transform="exp", type="est")


glm_plot6 = glm_plot6 +theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank())+scale_color_manual(values = c("black","black")) + theme(text = element_text(size = 10)) + ggtitle("R2A.CR") + coord_flip(clip = "off")+ scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.1, 10))

glm_int6 <- glm_plot_int6[[11]]

plot_data6 <- glm_int6$data

# Step 2: Create a new 'Media' column based on x
plot_data6$Media <- factor(ifelse(plot_data6$x == 1, "R2A", "CR"), levels = c("R2A", "CR"))

# Step 3: Create the plot colored by Media
glm_plot_int6 <- ggplot(plot_data6, aes(x = group, y = predicted, color = Media)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ facet) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("R2A" = "orange", "CR" = "darkgreen")) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "black")
  )+ ylab("ENS (q=1)")+xlab("Shake") + ggtitle("Effect plots for R2A.CR")

#Figure 4 - NMDS plot & final community composition

#Calculate bray curtis with relative abundance

pmxc = read.csv("~/Desktop/PMXC6_7_combined_ASVtable.csv", header=T)

#Subset by experiment and set treatment order for barplots

pmxc$Day = as.factor(pmxc$Day)

pmxc6 = pmxc[pmxc$Experiment == "PMXC6",]

pmxc6$Treatment <- factor(pmxc6$Treatment, levels = c("R2A", "CR", "SR2ARTNB", "SR2ARTB", "SR2AVTNB", "SR2AVTB","NSR2ARTNB", "NSR2ARTB", "NSR2AVTNB", "NSR2AVTB", "SCRRTNB", "SCRRTB", "SCRVTNB", "SCRVTB","NSCRRTNB", "NSCRRTB", "NSCRVTNB", "NSCRVTB"))

pmxc7 = pmxc[pmxc$Experiment == "PMXC7",]

pmxc7$Treatment <- factor(pmxc7$Treatment, levels = c("M9", "CR", "SM9RTNB", "SM9RTB", "SM9VTNB", "SM9VTB","NSM9RTNB", "NSM9RTB", "NSM9VTNB", "NSM9VTB", "SCRRTNB", "SCRRTB", "SCRVTNB", "SCRVTB","NSCRRTNB", "NSCRRTB", "NSCRVTNB", "NSCRVTB"))
#Subset ASV abundances and save as matrix
abund_table6 <- as.matrix(pmxc6[,2:29])
abund_table7 <- as.matrix(pmxc7[,2:29])

#Subset metadata and save as matrix
meta_table6 <- pmxc6[,30:43]
meta_table7 <- pmxc7[,30:43]

#Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
nmds6 = metaMDS(abund_table6, distance = "bray")

nmds7 = metaMDS(abund_table7, distance = "bray")
## Run 0 stress 0.1057221

## *** Best solution was not repeated -- monoMDS stopping criteria:
##     13: stress ratio > sratmax
##      7: scale factor of the gradient < sfgrmin

#Organize NMDS scores in data frame with metadata

data.scores6 = as.data.frame(scores(nmds6)$sites)

#add columns to data frame 
data.scores6$Sample = meta_table6$Sample
data.scores6$Time = meta_table6$Time
data.scores6$Media = meta_table6$Media
data.scores6$Treatment = meta_table6$Treatment
data.scores6$Beads = meta_table6$Beads
data.scores6$Shake = meta_table6$Shake
data.scores6$Temp = meta_table6$Temp

  mutate(across(starts_with("lfc_"), ~replace_na(., NA_real_)))

library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Prepare LFC, SE, significance
lfc_df <- full_res6 %>%
  select(taxon, starts_with("lfc_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon, names_to = "term", values_to = "lfc") %>%
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "^lfc_"))

sig_df <- full_res6 %>%
  select(taxon, starts_with("diff_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon, names_to = "term", values_to = "significant") %>%
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "^diff_"))

# Step 2: Merge, replace non-significant lfc with NA
plot_df6 <- lfc_df %>%
  left_join(sig_df, by = c("taxon", "term")) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    lfc = ifelse(significant, lfc, NA),
    term = str_replace_all(term, ":", " × ")  # for prettier facet labels
  )

physeq7
## phyloseq-class experiment-level object
## otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 26 taxa and 48 samples ]

meta7 = sample_data(metadata7)

meta7$Shake <- factor(meta7$Shake, levels=c("S", "NS"))
meta7$Media <- factor(meta7$Media, levels=c("M9", "CR"))
meta7$Temp <- factor(meta7$Temp, levels=c("RT", "VT"))
meta7$Beads <- factor(meta7$Beads, levels=c("NB", "B"))
meta7$Treatment <- factor(meta7$Treatment, levels=c("SM9RTNB", "SM9VTNB", "SM9VTB", "SM9RTB", "SCRVTNB", "SCRVTB", "SCRRTNB", "SCRRTB", "NSM9VTNB", "NSM9VTB", "NSM9RTNB", "NSM9RTB", "NSCRVTNB", "NSCRVTB", "NSCRRTNB", "NSCRRTB"))


physeq7 = merge_phyloseq(physeq7, meta7)
physeq7
## phyloseq-class experiment-level object
## otu_table()   OTU Table:         [ 26 taxa and 48 samples ]
## sample_data() Sample Data:       [ 48 samples by 9 sample variables ]
## tax_table()   Taxonomy Table:    [ 26 taxa by 7 taxonomic ranks ]
output7 = ancombc2(data = physeq7, assay_name = "counts", tax_level = NULL,
                       fix_formula = "Media * Shake * Temp * Beads",
                       p_adj_method = "fdr", pseudo_sens = TRUE,
                       prv_cut = 0.1,#change as needed, here prvcut set to only include ASV in 10 percent of samples, default is 30% 
                       alpha = 0.05, n_cl = 3, verbose = TRUE)

## [1]  22 129
#Ensuring all ASVs are included on y-axis
full_asv_list <- data.frame(taxon = taxa_names(physeq6))

full_res7 <- full_asv_list %>%
  left_join(output7_res, by = "taxon")

full_res7 <- full_res7 %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("diff_"), ~replace_na(., FALSE))) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("lfc_"), ~replace_na(., NA_real_)))

library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Prepare LFC, SE, significance
lfc_df <- full_res7 %>%
  select(taxon, starts_with("lfc_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon, names_to = "term", values_to = "lfc") %>%
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "^lfc_"))

sig_df <- full_res7 %>%
  select(taxon, starts_with("diff_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon, names_to = "term", values_to = "significant") %>%
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "^diff_"))

# Step 2: Merge, replace non-significant lfc with NA
plot_df7 <- lfc_df %>%
  left_join(sig_df, by = c("taxon", "term")) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    lfc = ifelse(significant, lfc, NA),
    term = str_replace_all(term, ":", " × ")  # for prettier facet labels
  )

# Step 3: Ensure factor levels to include all taxa and terms on axes
plot_df7$taxon <- factor(plot_df7$taxon, levels = unique(plot_df7$taxon))
plot_df7$term <- factor(plot_df7$term, levels = unique(plot_df7$term))
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Convert to relative abundance
physeq_rel6 <- transform_sample_counts(physeq6, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Step 2: Extract OTU table and ensure taxa are in rows
otu_mat6 <- as(otu_table(physeq_rel6), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_rel6)) {
  otu_mat6 <- t(otu_mat6)
}

# Step 3: Compute average relative abundance per taxon
avg_abund_df6 <- rowMeans(otu_mat6, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  enframe(name = "taxon", value = "mean_relative_abundance") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_relative_abundance))

# Step 1: Convert to relative abundance
physeq_rel7 <- transform_sample_counts(physeq7, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Step 2: Extract OTU table and ensure taxa are in rows

#Dot plot of ANCOMBC results where color = LFC and size = average relative abundance of each ASV at T12 in their respective experiments

#svglite("~/Desktop/PMXC_ANCOMBC_dotPlot_sizeRelAbun.svg", width=8, height=6)

ancom_plot = ggplot(ancombc_67, aes(x = term, y = taxon)) +
  # Background layer: all points (invisible, just to keep layout)
  geom_point(
    shape = 21, color = NA, fill = NA, stroke = 0, alpha = 0, size = 2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  # Foreground layer: only significant points
  geom_point(
    data = ancombc_67 %>% filter(significant),
    aes(fill = lfc, size = mean_relative_abundance),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("blue", "#E0E0E0", "red"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(-2, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 2)),
    limits = c(-10, 10),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Log Fold Change",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      frame.colour = "black",
      ticks.colour = "black",
      frame.linewidth = 0.3,
      ticks.linewidth = 0.3
    )
  ) +

  scale_size(
    range = c(2, 6),
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3),
    labels = c("<1%", "1%", "10%", "20%", "30%"),
    name = "Mean Relative Abundance"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = term_labels) +
  facet_wrap(~Experiment) +
  ylab("") + xlab("")

#Boxplot of relative abundances of two Pedobacter species (S17 and S2) in the M9.CR experiment, in SCRVTB and ~22% in SCRVTNB.

# Convert OTU/ASV table to matrix
otu_mat7 <- as(otu_table(physeq_rel7), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_rel7)) {
  otu_mat7 <- t(otu_mat7)
}

# Convert to dataframe and add ASV column
otu_df7 <- as.data.frame(otu_mat7)
otu_df7$ASV <- rownames(otu_mat7)

# Extract sample metadata
meta_df7 <- as.data.frame(sample_data(physeq_rel7))

# Combine OTU/ASV table with metadata
# Left join so metadata lines up with samples
otu_meta_df7 <- cbind(meta_df7, t(otu_df7[, -ncol(otu_df7)]))

# Subset to samples with the desired treatments
otu_sub <- subset(otu_meta_df7, Treatment %in% c("SCRVTB", "SCRVTNB"))

# Keep only metadata + the two ASVs of interest
otu_sub <- otu_sub[, c("Treatment", "ASV17", "ASV2")]

#Abundance boxplot

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)  # or tidyr::pivot_longer

# Convert to long format (ASV + abundance in one column)
otu_long <- reshape2::melt(otu_sub, id.vars = "Treatment", 
                 variable.name = "ASV", 
                 value.name = "Abundance")

# Make boxplot

#svglite("~/Desktop/PMXC_pedo_plot.svg", height=6, width=6)

ggplot(otu_long, aes(x = Treatment, y = Abundance, fill = ASV)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("ASV17" = "goldenrod3", 
               "ASV2"  = "darkorange3")
  ) +
  ylab("Relative Abundance")
